title: Urgency × Importance Routing and Material Recording Contract
purpose: Classify incoming material independently by urgency and importance, derive operational priority, and route durable records to canonical, memory, graph and receipt surfaces without confusing priority with epistemic truth.

urgency.U0: immediate: active data-loss, integrity, safety, security, blocking or irreversible-risk condition
urgency.U1: near-term: should be handled in the next operational window
urgency.U2: scheduled: relevant but can wait for planned execution

importance.I0: critical: provenance, custody, security, irreversible evidence, canonical architecture or hard invariant
importance.I1: high: core implementation, reproducibility, indexes, contracts, runtime or cross-system integration
importance.I2: medium: useful supporting material, optimization, documentation or exploratory implementation
importance.I3: low: optional context, analogy or deferred convenience

priority_policy.P0: reserve for high-urgency/high-importance operational risk; requires explicit observed reason
priority_policy.P1: important or time-sensitive work requiring near-term execution
priority_policy.TV: classification incomplete; preserve as TOKEN_VAZIO rather than guess
priority_policy.rule: urgency and importance are independent inputs; priority never promotes a scientific/technical claim

routing.operational_receipt: GitHub/Mapa/data/receipts/ or receipts/ according to existing domain convention
routing.raw_source_policy: raw source is not rewritten; normalized/indexed projections reference source provenance
routing.dedup_policy: do not blindly duplicate payloads; store canonical material once when possible and mirror references/receipts/projections
routing.all_places_semantics: all necessary functional surfaces, not every repository or folder indiscriminately
